what: FirstEnergy delivers electricity to more than six million customers across Ohio, Pennsylvania, West Virginia, Maryland and New Jersey, and owns over 24,000 miles of transmission lines.
customers: Households, businesses and industry across five Midwestern and mid-Atlantic states.
money: regulated electricity delivery across its utilities
moat: Delivery monopolies across five states with returns set by regulators, including federally regulated transmission that earns a formula-based return.
risks: Debt of about $28 billion against almost no cash
A bribery scandal in Ohio led to criminal charges and continuing litigation
Ohio regulators have been reviewing its rates and governance
Return on invested capital of about 5%
opportunities: Transmission investment earns steady federally regulated returns
Data centre interest in Ohio and Pennsylvania raises long-term load growth
watch: Ohio regulatory and legal outcomes, and transmission investment growth.
